tracks.desc: Practical AI guides — how models work, prompts, and building with AI tools. Expanding soon.

dsa.title: Quickselect Algorithm
dsa.desc: Find the kth smallest element in O(n) average time — animated partition walkthrough, code, questions and interview tips.

ai.title: How AI Actually Works
ai.desc: What models, training and predictions really mean — with a live next-word predictor, plain-English explanation, code, questions and interview tips.

ai.title: Prompting That Gets Results
ai.desc: The 4-part prompt formula — role, context, task, examples & checks. With a live prompt improver, quality-bar animation, prompt-builder code, questions and interview tips.

ai.title: Context & Memory
ai.desc: Why AI forgets mid-conversation and how to make it remember — live sliding context-window demo where tokens fill up, the oldest messages drop, and a memory toggle keeps key facts alive. Plus memory-builder code, questions and interview tips.

ai.title: Hallucinations & Verifying
ai.desc: Why AI invents confident-sounding facts — and how to catch them. Live confident-vs-true meter: drag a slider from raw guess to source-verified answer and watch confidence stay high while the truth gets checked. Plus claim-extraction code, practice questions and interview tips.

ai.title: Embeddings and Search
ai.desc: How AI turns words and concepts into numbers — live 2D semantic dot map where typing or clicking a word finds nearest neighbours with cosine similarity bars. Plus vector search code in Python & JavaScript, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and interview tips.

ai.title: Chat With Your Documents (RAG)
ai.desc: How AI searches your PDFs, wikis and notes to give fact-checked answers — live interactive RAG simulator with 3 sample documents, highlighted chunks and citations, plus a RAG on/off toggle comparing grounded answers with hallucinated guesses. Includes complete Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and interview tips.

ai.title: AI Agents That Do Tasks
ai.desc: How AI plans, uses tools and takes autonomous actions — live interactive agent simulator showing a task broken into planned steps with real-time tool calls (shop sale announcement), play/step/reset controls, and a human-approval gate toggle. Includes Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and interview tips.

ai.title: Image Generation Basics
ai.desc: How AI turns words into images with diffusion — live prompt-to-image simulator with progressive denoising steps, prompt strength (CFG scale) slider, latent space visualizer, Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and interview tips.

ai.title: Voice and Video AI
ai.desc: How AI synthesizes human voices, clones speech, and animates talking video avatars — live interactive text-to-speech phoneme visualizer, waveform pitch & speed controls, avatar viseme frame selector, complete Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and interview tips.

ai.title: AI for Resumes and Interviews
ai.desc: How to use AI to supercharge your resume bullets and ace interview prep — live interactive bullet optimizer with real-time impact score meter, STAR method interview answer transformer, complete Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and interview tips.

ai.title: AI for Small Business
ai.desc: How small businesses use AI to automate daily operations, WhatsApp customer inquiries, catalog price lists, and evening bookkeeping — live interactive shop day workflow animator with time-saved meter and cost comparison toggle, complete Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and business tips.

ai.title: AI Costs and Tokens
ai.desc: How AI token pricing works and how to forecast, monitor, and slash LLM API bills — live interactive token highlighter with real-time cost calculation in Rupees across 3 model tiers, plus a monthly budget planner simulator. Includes complete Python & JavaScript code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and cost-cutting tips.

ai.title: Privacy and Safety with AI
ai.desc: What leaves your device when you prompt AI, how providers use your data, and how to protect sensitive information — live interactive data flow animator with red/green risk meter, real-time PII sanitizer, and safety checklist. Includes Python & JavaScript anonymization code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and enterprise safety tips.

ai.title: Building with APIs
ai.desc: How software connects to AI models with REST APIs — live interactive API call builder with endpoint selector, auth headers, request payload constructor, JSON response inspector, and status code / error simulator. Includes Python & JavaScript integration code, 5 practice questions, 4 FAQs and production API tips.
